name: Golden Puffs / Honey Buzzers / Corn Bursts
whyItWorks: Puffed wheat and refined corn meal break down quickly (~1g fiber) in liquid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve with lactose-free or almond milk.
watchOuts: High sugar content in Golden Puffs can pull water into the colon (osmotic effect) if eaten in huge bowls during an active flare
